highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with upstream rendering fixes.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback can choose a different fontconfig face; use an explicit family, style, or bundled typeface when selection must be deterministic.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback can select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the prior FcFontSort fallback path. Applications that depend on the exact fontconfig fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; specify an explicit family and style, or bundle the required typeface.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153 and includes the corresponding upstream rendering fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update and its upstream rendering fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 carried release-line preparation for the upcoming 4.153 stable release.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It includes the current upstream rendering fixes and updates Linux font fallback behavior.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the m153 release for stabilization.
